items.title: Paul Barnes Interview, 1971-03-13
items.q: The only time I played on the boat was right here in New Orleans with Sidney Densene. ... I used to play on the Island Queen with Sidney Densene.

ctx.x: Uh-huh. I didn't think so, you know, because I know you and your brother are both musicians, and I was wondering, did you have other brothers and sisters who were musicians?

Yes, I had one, but he didn't take up an instrument, but he used to play a fife just like I did. Oh really? Yeah. Just the same as my oldest brother, Mealy. He's the ringleader of it. He played the fife. And during those times the fife was very popular around New Orleans. If you don't know what a fife is, it's just a little instrument with six holes in it. Something you would play like a piccolo. It didn't have keys on the side, just three little holes, but you would be surprised the music that we could get out…
Oh that's young. Well how old was your other brother? Was he older than you?
